resources.string: RECORDING AUDIO SYNC\nThe recorder aligns separate HLS audio and video from their source timestamps when those timestamps are reliable. For low-latency streams with timeline jumps, the recorder instead repairs the jumps; that may leave a constant audio offset. On the browser recording screen, Audio sync adjustment lets you correct a constant offset before starting. Positive values delay audio: if words are heard 2 seconds before the mouth moves, enter +2.00. Negative values advance audio: if words are heard 2 seconds late, enter -2.00. Use 0.00 to leave audio unadjusted. The setting is remembered separately for each website. Record a short sample before making a long recording; this setting cannot change a recording already saved.

QUICK START
Paste a webpage link, choose a format, and tap Download. Files are saved in Downloads/yt-dlp Mobile.

FORMATS
MP4 compatibility is the best first choice for YouTube and ordinary players. Best available quality may create WebM/MKV or fail when a site does not offer a compatible video/audio pair. MP3 and M4A extract audio.

MAXIMUM SPEED
Parallel fragments can improve HLS/DASH speed. The app automatically retries once without parallel fragments after 403, 429, or repeated fragment failures. Turn it off for sensitive servers.

BROWSER ASSISTED DOWNLOAD
Use this after a 403, browser-impersonation error, or protected webpage failure. Wait for ads to finish, play the real video, then tap Detect and download. This path finds a direct media URL for yt-dlp; it does not use the stream recorder. Control responses and incomplete media are rejected. Captured links expire, so use them promptly.

BROWSER ASSISTED RECORDING
Open the page through Browser-assisted stream recording, finish any advertisement, play and unmute the actual video, then tap Find stream & record. This uses a continuous HLS/DASH playlist or a YouTube live page. Keep the player running in the browser while the foreground service records; closing the page or switching apps may interrupt some sites. Short segments and MP4 clips cannot be recorded continuously. Stop & save on the browser page, notification, or main screen exports the actual recorded container to Downloads/yt-dlp Mobile/Recordings. If audio is uncertain, choose Continue or Cancel and check a short recording. Some protected sites reject background stream requests, and DRM streams are unsupported.

COOKIES
Import a Netscape-format cookies.txt only when a site requires your signed-in session. Treat it like a password. Remove it when no longer needed. Imported cookies are used by yt-dlp downloads; they do not sign in the separate Browser Assist WebView. --cookies and --cookies-from-browser are intentionally blocked in Extra arguments.

COMMON ERRORS
403/Forbidden: update yt-dlp, clear unnecessary Extra arguments, try MP4 compatibility, then Browser Assist.
410/Gone: the captured media link expired; reopen Browser Assist and play the video again.
Sign in to confirm you are not a bot: YouTube does not trust the current network/IP. Import cookies from your own session or change networks, then retry.
No stream found: wait for ads and previews to finish, play the main video for several seconds, and detect again.
White page after Continue with Google in Browser Assist: Google sign-in may not work inside the embedded browser. Return to the site and use its email-and-password sign-in if available; this applies to downloads and stream recording.
X post downloads only audio: Browser Assist can select the separate audio playlist. Import Netscape-format cookies.txt exported from a browser signed into your X account, paste the full x.com post URL on the main screen, and tap Download. Do not use the video.twimg.com /mp4a/ playlist URL.
X still asks to sign in: sometimes you may also need to sign in to X within Browser Assist, open the post, and select Show on its content warning. Then return to the main screen and retry Download with the full post URL and imported cookies. Browser Assist and yt-dlp have separate sign-in sessions.
Network or VPN changed: signed media URLs can be tied to the old IP. Normal downloads retry extraction on the new connection; browser-captured links must be captured again.

PLAYLISTS, SUBTITLES & EXTRA ARGUMENTS
Enable Full playlist only when wanted. Subtitle languages accept yt-dlp patterns such as en.* or en.*,es. Extra arguments are the part after yt-dlp; app-managed output, cookie, executable, and config options are blocked.

UPDATES & LIMITATIONS
When idle, each fresh app launch checks the yt-dlp nightly engine. Offline checks do not block downloads. Some sites require PO tokens, browser impersonation components unavailable on Android, account access, a permitted region, or unsupported DRM; the app cannot bypass those protections. Download only media you are authorized to save.
